samples.title: Imperial costume & jewelry
samples.instruction: Enhance the scene with period-accurate, ornate headpieces featuring intricate floral and gemstone details, replacing the simpler hair accessories. Transform the modern-style clothing into richly embroidered traditional garments with high collars and detailed patterns; the foreground figure wears a vibrant green robe with floral embroidery and a dark blue collar, while the background figure wears a cream-colored robe with red floral accents and a red headband. Apply dramatic, cinematic lighting with warm, directional highlights and deep shadows to emphasize texture and depth. Enhance the makeup with defined eyes, subtle contouring, and a refined, regal look. Maintain the original composition, facial expressions, and camera framing while enriching the background with subtle, historically inspired textures and patterns to suggest an opulent interior setting. Preserve the characters' identities, actions, and spatial relationships.

samples.title: A temple at golden hour
samples.instruction: Render the video in a mystical, golden-hour fantasy style with long shadows, ethereal light beams, and a sense of ancient timelessness, turning the temple into a forgotten god’s dwelling.

samples.title: From a modern garden to a period courtyard
samples.instruction: Transform the modern outdoor setting into an ornate traditional Chinese courtyard with red-painted wooden architecture, intricate lattice windows, and tiled roofs. Replace the casual clothing with elaborate traditional garments: the woman on the left wears a soft pink Hanfu with embroidered cuffs, and the woman on the right wears a layered brown and gray robe with a sash. Add traditional hairpins and accessories to their updos. Replace the modern white lantern with a classic Chinese stone lantern. Enhance the lighting to be warm and atmospheric, with soft shadows and a golden-hour glow. Maintain the same camera angle, character positions, and interaction, preserving the scene's composition and timing. Add subtle atmospheric effects like floating cherry blossom petals and a slightly hazy, cinematic depth to the background.

samples.title: A richly dressed palace interior
samples.instruction: Transform the modern, minimalist interior into an ornate, traditional Chinese-style setting with dark wooden shelves, intricate carvings, and classical decorative panels. Replace the contemporary clothing with elaborate traditional attire: the standing woman wears a beige robe with red embroidered collar and cuffs, while the seated woman wears a rich green robe with detailed floral embroidery. Add traditional hair accessories—flower ornaments for the standing woman and an ornate headdress with jewels for the seated woman. Replace the modern props (vases, blue flowers) with classical items: a dried floral arrangement in a bronze vase, antique porcelain vases, and a wooden box. Enhance the lighting to warm, dramatic, stylized illumination with soft backlighting and golden tones, emphasizing depth and texture. Maintain the original camera position, shot scale, and character poses, preserving the scene’s layout and action.

samples.title: A warm, nostalgic kitchen
samples.instruction: Transform the entire video into a nostalgic, grainy home video aesthetic with slight color fading, VHS-style tracking lines, and a warm sepia tint reminiscent of family memories.

samples.title: A cityscape in sepia
samples.instruction: Render the cityscape in the style of a 19th-century etching, with fine crosshatching, sepia tones, and a sense of historical grandeur, as if capturing a moment from a forgotten atlas.

samples.title: Embroidered robes in a garden
samples.instruction: Transform the modern casual attire into traditional Chinese Qing dynasty-style garments: replace the gray t-shirt and blue overalls with intricately embroidered, high-collared robes in muted gray and dark blue, featuring detailed floral and cloud patterns along the collar and sleeves. Upgrade the simple hairstyles with elaborate, historically accurate hairdos—black buns adorned with red ribbons, floral ornaments, and tassels. Replace the plain background with a lush, verdant garden filled with dense green foliage, enhancing the natural atmosphere. Add subtle period-appropriate jewelry: small, delicate earrings and a black beaded necklace. Apply cinematic color grading with a slightly desaturated, warm tone to evoke historical authenticity, while preserving the original camera framing, character positions, and facial expressions.

samples.title: A moody palace conversation
samples.instruction: Transform the modern casual attire into ornate traditional Chinese clothing: replace the black sweatshirt with a rich red qipao featuring intricate floral embroidery on the collar and shoulders. Change the simple bun hairstyle into an elaborate traditional updo with green jade hairpins and decorative black hair accessories. Replace the plain background with a rainy, atmospheric palace courtyard featuring blurred traditional architecture and falling rain. Enhance the lighting to be soft and dramatic, with a moody, cinematic color grade emphasizing deep reds and muted tones. Add subtle rain effects and atmospheric haze to the scene. Keep the same camera angle, shot scale, and character positions, preserving the interaction and facial expressions.

samples.title: A storybook afternoon
samples.instruction: Render the scene in a soft, pastel-colored children’s storybook style with gentle shading and whimsical details, like floating thought bubbles above the man’s head.

samples.title: Lanterns in a cinematic courtyard
samples.instruction: Transform the modern, simplified setting into a richly detailed traditional Chinese courtyard. Replace the plain white lanterns with ornate, dark metal lanterns featuring glowing candles inside, mounted on stone pedestals. Update the architecture to include traditional Chinese-style roof tiles, decorative eaves, and painted wooden beams with intricate carvings. Change the character's casual attire to a dark, period-appropriate robe with a red hat, maintaining their crouched posture and interaction with the object on the ground. Enhance the background with detailed wall paintings and textured stone facades. Adjust the lighting to be warm and atmospheric, with soft candlelight casting dramatic shadows, creating a cinematic, historical ambiance. Preserve the original camera angle, character position, and scene layout.

realWorld.title: Basketball, reimagined as wuxia
realWorld.instruction: Transform the basketball game video into a high-budget cinematic Wuxia movie scene. The two players are now wearing elegant, flowing ancient Chinese Hanfu robes with wide sleeves. The basketball court is replaced by an ancient, weathered stone training platform located high in the misty mountains, surrounded by a dense bamboo forest and traditional wooden pagodas. Add dramatic golden hour sunlight filtering through the leaves, creating long shadows and atmospheric haze.

realWorld.title: An everyday café becomes a piano lounge
realWorld.instruction: Transform the café into a luxurious piano lounge with crystal chandeliers, dark wood paneling, and warm cinematic lighting. Dress the pianist in a black tuxedo and the guests in elegant evening wear. Give the piano a polished black finish. Preserve faces, playing motions, keyboard alignment, and camera movement.
